description: Revoke a third-party app's access to the user's Agentcard account. Disconnects the app and invalidates its OAuth tokens; it must reconnect via OAuth to regain access. Pass the clientId shown by list_connections.

client_id.description: The OAuth client ID of the app to revoke (from list_connections).

name: revoke_connection

clientId.description: The client ID that was revoked.

revoked.description: Number of OAuth tokens that were revoked.

status.description: Result status: "revoked" when tokens were invalidated, "not_connected" when the app had no active access.
